compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want snapshot isolation plus rebase-then-retry on tickets-branch writes, so that concurrent local commits do not corrupt reconciler-produced state.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Before any Jira write, reconciler re-reads tickets-branch HEAD. Tickets-branch writes follow rebase-then-retry (3 attempts) then reject-and-reschedule.

## Done Definitions
- Reconciler re-reads tickets-branch HEAD before any Jira mutation; if HEAD changed, pass aborts and reschedules ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Tickets-branch writes succeed under simulated concurrent commits within 3 rebase-and-retry attempts ← Satisfies: sc-2
- After 3 failed rebase-and-retry attempts, pass exits with reject-and-reschedule status and next scheduled pass picks up cleanly ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations
- [Risk] Snapshot-isolation aborts must emit a structured event so health module can distinguish abort-due-to-drift from abort-due-to-error.
- [Reliability] All Jira API calls must be wrapped with a per-call timeout (30s) and treat timeout as a retryable error with exponential backoff, so that a hanging Jira call does not hold the GHA concurrency slot for the full 15-min ceiling.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
